notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Whisper, Blood Liturgist.
Whisper, Blood Liturgist does not have summoning sickness.
You control two additional creatures.
description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing itself.
Whisper's ability from Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Whisper.
Resolve Sling-Gang Lieutenant's ability, causing target player to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Whisper's own ability by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures.
Whisper's ability from Thornbite Staff triggers twice, untapping Whisper twice.
Resolve Whisper's ability, returning Sling-Gang Lieutenant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sling-Gang Lieutenant enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Repeat.
